title: w-c205 slice C-floor: restart-safe custody of a non-admission session_bind under a coordinated reader floor
outcome: A non-admission SessionBind whose outcome is unknown keeps its exact original request (session, idempotency key, intent) durably across a host crash or restart. It is persisted under a coordinated semantic reader floor and migration, or in an existing representation proven to preserve it through every supported writer, so boot recovery replays it identically instead of minting a new key.
acceptance: w-c205 slice C-floor: restart-safe custody of a non-admission session_bind under a coordinated reader floor is done
